title: ayapana elata
intro: Ayapana elata, commonly known as Black Sampala or Black Kola, is a plant species in the sunflower family that is native to tropical regions. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, as well as the potential to support immune function and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Ayapana elata are attributed to its ability to modulate the body's response to inflammation and infection, and to promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
